title: Using AI to reverse engineer hardware
summary: An article exploring how AI technologies can assist in reverse engineering hardware components, covering techniques for analyzing chips, firmware, and undocumented hardware specifications through machine learning approaches.
problem_solved: Automates and accelerates the complex process of reverse engineering proprietary hardware for which documentation is unavailable.
why_valuable: Enables security researchers and developers to understand undocumented hardware faster, supporting security auditing, compatibility work, and hardware hacking.
